hints: Take one node with a left subtree. In the finished chain, what comes immediately after the last node of that left subtree?
Whatever used to be the node's right child - because the left subtree is walked completely before the right one.
So find the rightmost node of the left subtree, hang the node's right subtree off it, then move the whole left subtree across to the right and clear the left.
Then move on to the node's new right child and repeat. Every node is visited a constant number of times, so the walk stays linear even though finding the rightmost node looks like extra work.
